sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your counter-offer. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

As the owner of our family foundry, I am pleased to support our long-standing partnership by agreeing to your request for a 24-month contract, providing both of us with planning security. For this relationship, our Angebot stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.80 per unit, with a price of €51.80 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

We take great pride in our craft and our people, and we look forward to continuing our tradition of shared success together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: 跟进：以下是我们的修订报价。希望双方一如既往互相理解。

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We are surprised to see that your revised price proposal is lower than your previous offer.
We have already made significant concessions to support our long-standing partnership by agreeing to a 24-month contract and extended 60-day payment terms.
Therefore, we must maintain our offer of €52.20 per unit for this package.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
